description: This file implements tracing and profiling utilities for Chromium's build system, including classes and functions for logging, summarizing, and exporting trace events in JSON format.

classes.name: TraceLog
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe collection of trace events, allowing addition and retrieval of events.

classes.name: TraceItem
classes.description: Represents a single trace event with type, name, thread ID, and timing information.

classes.name: ScopedTrace
classes.description: A RAII helper for automatically creating and finalizing trace events within a scope.

methods.name: TraceLog::Add
methods.description: Adds a new trace event to the log.

methods.name: TraceLog::events
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe copy of all trace events.

methods.name: TraceItem::TraceItem
methods.description: Constructor for creating a trace event with specified type, name, and thread ID.

methods.name: ScopedTrace::ScopedTrace
methods.description: Creates a trace event at scope entry, recording start time.

methods.name: ScopedTrace::~ScopedTrace
methods.description: Finalizes the trace event at scope exit.

methods.name: ScopedTrace::SetToolchain
methods.description: Associates a toolchain label with the trace event.

methods.name: ScopedTrace::SetCommandLine
methods.description: Associates a command line with the trace event.

methods.name: AddTrace
methods.description: Adds a trace event to the global log.

methods.name: SummarizeTraces
methods.description: Generates a summary report of collected trace events.

methods.name: SaveTraces
methods.description: Exports trace events to a JSON file for visualization.
